changeSet.sql: CREATE TYPE competition_level AS ENUM ('CITY', 'REGION', 'NATIONAL', 'OPEN'); CREATE TYPE competition_status AS ENUM ('INCOMING', 'INPROGRESS', 'FINISHED', 'ARCHIVED');
